hsubtext: Over 15 years of property expertise at the service of our clients.
historytext: Founded on 5 October 2007 in Yaoundé, Société Civile Immobilière AFG was established with a clear ambition: to offer every Cameroonian, every business and every institution access to high-quality property, managed with rigour and transparency.
hissubtext: What began as a vision has evolved over the years into a diversified property portfolio, covering the country’s major cities — from Douala to Kribi, from Yaoundé to Garoua. Today, SCI AFG is much more than a property company: it guarantees land and property security for its clients, both individuals and businesses.
rendre: Making quality property accessible to all
missiontext: Our primary mission is to meet the property needs of national and international companies and organisations by providing them with comfortable accommodation for their executives and offices suited to their activities.
missubtext: Beyond the professional sphere, SCI AFG is also committed to supporting households by offering them comfortable homes at affordable prices. We firmly believe that every family deserves a decent, secure and well-maintained home.
etre: To be the leading real estate partner in Cameroon
visiontext: Our vision is to cover all ten regions of the country with an ever-more-diverse portfolio of properties, whilst maintaining the standards of quality and transparency that have built our reputation since 2007.
vissubtext: We believe in a people-centred approach to property, where every client — whether an individual, a business or an investor — finds exactly what they are looking for, under the best possible conditions.
transtext: At SCI AFG, there are no hidden fees, no commissions and no unpleasant surprises. Every contract is clear, every charge is justified and every commitment is honoured.
rigtext: From rental management to the maintenance of our properties, we apply strict standards to ensure our clients’ properties are always in perfect condition.
proxtext: Nous ne disparaissons pas après la remise des clés. Notre équipe assure un suivi quotidien de chaque client pour répondre à ses besoins et anticiper ses attentes.
transmitext: Nous construisons des relations durables fondées sur la confiance. La fidélité de nos clients — particuliers, entreprises et institutions — est notre plus grande fierté.
